# Ágora

> Red verificada para la comunidad UDLAP (Universidad de las Américas Puebla).
> Solo entra quien tiene correo @udlap.mx. Proyecto independiente, no afiliado a la universidad.

## Site

- Home / login: https://udlagora.com/
- Registro de perfil: https://udlagora.com/registro
- Bienvenida: https://udlagora.com/bienvenida
- Términos: https://udlagora.com/terminos
- Privacidad: https://udlagora.com/privacidad
- Sitemap: https://udlagora.com/sitemap.xml
- Contacto: contacto@udlagora.com

## Product

Ágora is a campus social network: feed, communities derived from academic graph,
events, marketplace, DMs, and verified identity via institutional email OTP.
User-generated content is not mass-indexed; public share previews are minimal
(title, excerpt, image) for Open Graph unfurls.
